entries.note: this is the entry DC-005 corrected; before the correction the code constrained the band's whole extent, which was stricter and unregistered
entries.registered_text: the band's argmax must not sit on either endpoint of the layer range, since a maximum at an endpoint is what a monotone trend looks like, not a band
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: computes peak_layer = argmax of readrate WITHIN the band, then requires layers[0] < peak_layer < layers[-1]. It constrains the ARGMAX, not the extent.

entries.divergence_examined: token_before_target and final_prompt_token resolve to the same index because these prompts stop immediately before the answer; this is stated in the code comment and is a property of the data, not a harmonisation
entries.registered_text: {"multihop": "the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` itself is not scored", "multilingual": "the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` itself is not scored", "order-ops": "the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` itself is not scored", "poetry": "the last newline token, end of line 1 of the couplet", "association": "the final prompt token, the closing period", "typo": "the final prompt token, the last tokenizer fragment of the misspelling", "order_ops_special_rule": "each intermediate is a key expanded to a synonym set (numbers to digit and word forms, operations to symbol and word forms); the rank at each layer is the MINIMUM over the single-token synonyms", "these_are_not_simplified_or_harmonised": true}

entries.what_the_code_actually_does: multihop / multilingual / order-ops use token_before_target; poetry uses last_newline_token, scanning backwards for a token containing a newline and RAISING if none is found; association / typo use final_prompt_token

entries.caveat: the explicit synonym lists are a RECONSTRUCTION of the published rule; the README states the rule but does not publish the lists. This is disclosed in every rank report under method.order_ops_synonym_expansion_is_a_reconstruction.
entries.registered_text: each intermediate is a key expanded to a synonym set (numbers to digit and word forms, operations to symbol and word forms); the rank at each layer is the MINIMUM over the single-token synonyms
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: expands numbers to digit and word forms and operations to symbol and word forms, then keeps only forms that encode to exactly ONE token; the rank at each layer is the min over those ids

entries.registered_text: band derived from the pooled profile, with per-set profiles still reported
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: reads real_report['pooled_profile']['1']; per-set profiles are retained in the rank report

entries.registered_text: if the maximum readrate is 0, no content is readable at any layer and NO band exists; this is reported as such and is not rescued by lowering k
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: an all-zero profile gives real lower bounds of 0, which cannot exceed a positive null ceiling, so no layer is significant and no band is produced; k is never raised to rescue it

entries.registered_text: at least at least 5 independent random lenses
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: null_ceiling raises ValueError when fewer replicates are supplied

entries.registered_text: the MAXIMUM of the per-replicate upper confidence bounds, which is the conservative direction
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: takes max over replicates of each layer's Wilson upper bound
two-sided 95 percent, z = 1.959963984540054, used in the Wilson interval

entries.note: Wilson rather than the normal approximation, because at zero observed hits the normal interval collapses to a point and one lucky hit would clear it
entries.registered_text: binomial confidence interval over item x intermediate trials
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: Wilson score interval on item x intermediate trials; a layer is significant when the real LOWER bound exceeds the null ceiling, so the intervals must not overlap

entries.registered_text: the scale-free 'at least half of the profile's own maximum' rule, which is the element that failed
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: no half-of-maximum threshold appears anywhere in the band extractor

entries.registered_text: per layer, replace J_l with a random matrix of the SAME Frobenius norm, leaving the entire rest of the readout path unchanged
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: each J_l is replaced by a Gaussian matrix rescaled to the identical Frobenius norm; the caller asserts the worst relative norm deviation is below 1e-5 before scoring
